summary: Google Ads API error bodies keep up to 4096 bytes and are cut on a valid UTF-8 boundary with a visible ... marker.
reason: Google Ads puts the specific errorCode after the first ~200 bytes of pretty-printed JSON, so a 200-byte cut made distinct query errors indistinguishable; a byte slice could also split a multibyte character.
validated_outcome: TestTruncateBody covers short, at-limit, over-limit and a rune split at the limit.
